title: Joining the congregation late
intro: If we come late to the jama‘ah, we still join – and make up the rak‘ahs we missed.

learn.html: A prayer in jama‘ah is worth more than a prayer alone, so we try to pray in jama‘ah as often as we can. If we come late, it is important to know the rules for joining.

learn.text: When the imam has already started the fard

items: join the jama‘ah and pray behind the imam
remember how many rak‘ahs you missed
do not give the salam with the imam
when the imam gives the salam to the right and starts turning to the left, stand up and make up the missed rak‘ahs

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: If you join and manage to say “Subhaana Rabbiyal-‘Azeem” once in ruku‘, you have caught that rak‘ah and don’t need to make it up. If you join before the imam gives the salam, you get the reward of praying in jama‘ah.

learn.text: How to make up the missed rak‘ahs

items: Missed the 1st rak‘ah: after the imam’s salam, stand up, pray the 1st rak‘ah, then the last sitting and salam.

Missed the 1st and 2nd of a 4-rak‘ah prayer: stand up, pray the 1st and 2nd rak‘ah, then the last sitting and salam. In Maghrib, sit for At-Tahiyyat after the first made-up rak‘ah, then stand for the second.
Missed the 1st, 2nd and 3rd of a 4-rak‘ah prayer: pray the 1st rak‘ah, sit for At-Tahiyyat, stand and pray the 2nd and 3rd, then the last sitting and salam.
Missed all four: pray four rak‘ahs as if praying alone, then the last sitting and salam.

learn.title: Important
learn.html: When making up rak‘ahs, after every two rak‘ahs you must sit – whether you prayed them with the imam or alone.

practice.title: Coming late – what to do
items: Join and pray behind the imam
Remember how many rak‘ahs you missed
Stay seated when the imam gives salam
Stand up and make up the missed rak‘ahs

practice.title: Did you catch the rak‘ah?
practice.prompt: Tap every case where you have caught the rak‘ah, then tap Check.

options.text: I joined while the imam was reciting Al-Fatiha
I said “Subhaana Rabbiyal-‘Azeem” once in ruku‘ with the imam
I joined when the imam was already in sajdah
options.why: You must catch the ruku‘ – a rak‘ah joined after ruku‘ has to be made up.

options.text: I arrived after the imam rose from ruku‘
options.why: The ruku‘ is already over, so that rak‘ah has to be made up.

questions.q: Can we still join the jama‘ah if we come late?
What do we do with the sunnah when the imam has started the fard?
Do we give the salam with the imam if we missed rak‘ahs?
options: No – we stand up and make them up

questions.q: When have we caught the rak‘ah?
options: If we say “Subhaana Rabbiyal-‘Azeem” once in ruku‘
If we arrive after the salam

questions.q: What must we do after every two rak‘ahs when making up?
We missed all four rak‘ahs. What do we do?
options: Pray four rak‘ahs as if alone, then sit and give salam

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 📖 Finish the story two ways – once where Ahmed must make up the 1st rak‘ah and once where he doesn’t: Ahmed was coming home from school and went into the masjid to pray Dhuhr. His efendi was already in the ruku‘ of the first rak‘ah. Ahmed…
🕌 Act it out in class: one pupil is the imam, the others come late to different rak‘ahs and show how to join.
